pricing.basis: reference: claude-sonnet-5-5 list price ($2 in, $0.20 cached, $10 out per Mtok)

workloads.name: simple
workloads.description: say hello in French; no tool needed

workloads.name: tool-lookup
workloads.description: convert miles to km with a tool that must be discovered among 20 actions

workloads.name: multi-step
workloads.description: find a customer, list her orders, add the amounts

workloads.name: large-output
workloads.description: find the one error code in 3,000 log lines

workloads.name: long-session
workloads.description: many short turns, each with one tool call; context must not grow

workloads.name: failure-recovery
workloads.description: primary mirror is down; retry at most once, then use the backup

workloads.name: duplicate
workloads.description: the model repeats an identical lookup three times

workloads.name: runaway
workloads.description: the model repeats one search forever; the stall guard must stop it

workloads.name: resume
workloads.description: look up a customer, restart, then ask about the same customer

workloads.name: retrieval
workloads.description: find a warranty period in one of 120 stored product documents

workloads.name: approval
workloads.description: save a note; the write goes through the approval gate

workloads.name: parallel
workloads.description: three independent slow lookups requested together
